heading: Diwali Bonus Tax: What Salaried Employees Need to Know
tldr: A Diwali bonus received from your employer is fully taxable as part of your salary income.
This bonus is added to your total income and taxed at your applicable income tax slab rate.
Your employer typically accounts for this bonus when calculating Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) throughout the financial year.
Cash gifts from employers are generally not considered tax-exempt gifts but are treated as salary.
You must report your Diwali bonus under "Salaries" when filing your Income Tax Return (ITR).
caption:
That extra Diwali cash from your boss? It’s a wonderful treat, but here's a quick heads-up: it's not totally free from tax. Think of it like a regular part of your salary. This means a portion of it will go towards taxes, just like your monthly pay. Your employer usually sorts this out, but it's good to know how it works for your own finances.
